test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I:** All leopards are cheetahs.

**Statement II:** No cheetah is a cat.

**Conclusion I:** Some cats are leopards.

**Conclusion II:** Some cats are cheetahs.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statement:

I. All leopards are cheetahs.

II. No cheetah is a cat.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a99962e0260372988d5b313e5cff7e8ac3016940fa1ec708cad4fbc8d98fb9b.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some cats are leopards - False (Because No definite relation given between them, so it can be possible only).

(ii) Some cats are cheetahs - False (Because No cheetah is a cat).

Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
